$comment: Shared design tokens (spec §7). Remotion imports this file; tools/gen-theme.py writes CarKit/Theme/ThemeTokens.swift from it. Edit here, then run python3 tools/gen-theme.py.

bold.$comment: Bold look (spec §3): each source's full-colour tile. Turns amber/red when due, AQI band colour for haze.

neon.$comment: Neon look (spec §3): each source's glow colour on near-black.

fonts.$comment: The app uses SF Pro / SF Pro Rounded. Videos use the closest open fonts (Google Fonts, OFL).
